title: Application of the Commonwealth Electric Company, pursuant to G.L. Chapter 164, Sec. 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell up to 237,500 shares of common capital stock, $25 par value, at no less than par; to issue, on a negotiated basis, unsecured long-term debt in an aggregate principal amount of up to $50,000,000; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, Sec. 15.
